title: Chio TenantPolicy
description: Per-tenant ExpectedIdentity policy file. TOML on disk, canonical JSON for signing. Single source of truth: `crates/chio-attest-verify/src/policy.rs`. The `pq_identity_regexps` field is filled in once ML-DSA cert identities stabilise.

tenant_id.description: Stable opaque tenant identifier. Two policies with the same tenant_id collide; the loader rejects the second one fail-closed.

version.description: Schema-version integer. Currently must equal 1; future format breaks bump this and add an explicit migration path.

identity_regexps.description: Non-empty list of Fulcio SAN regex strings. The verifier anchors each regex at both ends; callers MUST NOT include their own `^` / `$`.

oidc_issuers.description: Non-empty list of OIDC issuer URLs. Verification fails closed unless the cert's OIDC issuer matches one of them exactly.

signed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp recording when the policy was signed. The loader rejects policies older than its staleness horizon (default 90 days).

signature.description: Base64-encoded Sigstore signature over the canonical JSON serialisation of every other field. Verified through the same SigstoreVerifier surface every other attestation flows through.

pq_identity_regexps.description: Reserved for ML-DSA cert identities. Empty until ML-DSA cert support lands. Adding entries beforehand is a no-op until the loader recognises ML-DSA cert families.
